name: Sepang International Circuit
notes: Sepang International Circuit (clockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 5489 m vs 5543 m. Start line in the middle of the pit straight. One DRS zone on the pit straight as in 2012 (in reality the detection point was on the back straight). Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
